items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: So the pay-off was to make the picture with Louis Armstrong and Mae West, "Every Day's a Holiday."

ctx.x: This might have been '37. This probably was '37. And we marched down Broadway in L.A. and the crowd just followed us all the way to City Hall. And we won this prize. I led the parade with my clarinet, let the band. And we won the prize.
So the pay-off was to make the picture with Louis Armstrong and Mae West, "Every Day's a Holiday." Now, in the picture, Louis MARCHED in front of the band and I was
holding a trombone in the picture. But that's how we got that picture.
